zh: n 最多 5000，直接模拟每一轮也只有约 n²/2 次加法，完全来得及。
新一轮的第 i 项只依赖上一轮的第 i 项和第 i+1 项；从左往右原地覆盖时，右边的旧值还没被改写，所以不需要额外数组。
有效长度 length 从 n 开始，当 length>2 时，对 i=0..length-2 令 a[i]=(a[i]+a[i+1]) mod 10，然后 length 减一；最后把 a[0] 和 a[1] 作为两个字符连在一起输出，前导 0 要保留。
en: n is at most 5000, so simulating every round directly takes only about n^2/2 additions, which is easily fast enough.

Item i of the next round depends only on items i and i+1 of the previous round; overwriting in place from left to right leaves the old value on the right untouched until it is used, so no extra array is needed.

Start with length = n; while length > 2, set a[i] = (a[i] + a[i+1]) mod 10 for i = 0..length-2 and then decrease length by one; finally print a[0] and a[1] as two characters next to each other, keeping a leading 0.

explanationEn:
## Approach

In each round, overwrite in place toward the left with the adjacent sums mod 10, shrinking the effective length until it is 2.

## Correctness

Item i of a round depends only on the old items i and i+1, and when updating from left to right the old value on the right has not been overwritten yet, so the in-place update matches the definition exactly; induction gives the final two digits.

## Complexity

Time O(n^2), space O(n).
